title: JVM internals for Kotlin and Android developers
intro: Trace a tiny bookmark program from compiled instructions to method frames, shared objects and reachability.
how: Start by tracing one tiny program. Use the browser workbench to predict what changes in a frame or on the heap. Then use a local JDK to compare the model with compiled instructions and run the shared-counter exercise.

modules.title: From source to a live object
modules.blurb: Follow one counter from a class file to frames, references, reachability and a change two threads share.

modules.title: Reading bytecode
modules.blurb: Read javap output line by line: the operand stack, the constant pool, the five calls, and what Kotlin compiles to.

modules.title: Loading and linking code
modules.blurb: When a class arrives, who loads it, why two loaders mean two classes, and where class metadata lives.

modules.title: How the JVM makes code fast
modules.blurb: Why the first calls are slow, how HotSpot picks methods to compile, what inlining, escape analysis and deoptimization do, how to measure honestly, and how to start faster.
